title: H.C. Wainwright raises Riot price target to $40 on AI data-center pipeline
excerpt: The analyst assigns half of Riot’s valuation to prospective site conversions, including a possible 756 MW critical IT deployment at Corsicana.
content_html:
William Foxley

Tue, August 11, 2026 at 10:58 AM EDT 2 min read

H.C. Wainwright raised its Riot (NASDAQ: RIOT) price target to $40 from $25 on Tuesday, maintaining a Buy rating after the operator expanded its contracted AI data-center capacity at Rockdale.

Analyst Michael Colonnese's sum-of-the-parts valuation assigns $18 per share to Riot's operating businesses. Its 11,380 bitcoin holdings contribute another $2 per share. Risk-weighted near-term data-center conversions account for the remaining $20.

The revised target reflects Riot's 20-year lease covering 191 MW of critical IT capacity at Rockdale with frontier AI lab Anthropic. Riot expects $9.1 billion of contract revenue and $7.3 billion to $8.2 billion of cumulative net operating income during the initial term.

Riot plans to deliver 96 MW in December 2027, followed by the final 95 MW by June 2028. A $573 million interim financing agreement with Morgan Stanley will cover initial development costs while Riot finalizes an investment-grade credit backstop.

The lease follows Riot's earlier agreement with AMD, bringing contracted Rockdale capacity to 241 MW and long-term contracted revenue to about $9.8 billion. Riot delivered AMD's initial 25 MW during the second quarter and is developing another 25 MW for delivery by May 2027.

H.C. Wainwright included Riot's prospective Corsicana conversion in its valuation. The 1 GW site can support up to 756 MW of critical IT load, but one tenant has only provided a letter of intent that is non-binding for that capacity while commercial and design discussions continue.

Riot ended June with $548.9 million of cash and bitcoin valued at about $666 million. H.C. Wainwright identified bitcoin-price volatility, network hash-rate growth, Rockdale construction delays and dilution from secondary equity sales as risks to its valuation.

威廉·福克斯利

H.C. 周二，Wainwright 将 Riot（纳斯达克股票代码：RIOT）的目标股价从 25 美元上调至 40 美元，在该运营商扩大了 Rockdale 的人工智能数据中心合同容量后，维持买入评级。

分析师 Michael Colonnese 的综合估值将 Riot 运营业务的估值定为每股 18 美元。 其持有的 11,380 枚比特币每股又贡献了 2 美元。 剩余的 20 美元用于风险加权的近期数据中心转换。

修订后的目标反映了 Riot 与前沿 AI 实验室 Anthropic 签订的 20 年租约，涵盖 Rockdale 191 MW 的关键 IT 容量。 Riot预计初期合同收入为91亿美元，累计净营业收入为73亿至82亿美元。

Riot计划于2027年12月交付96兆瓦，并于2028年6月交付最终的95兆瓦。 Riot 与摩根士丹利达成的 5.73 亿美元临时融资协议将支付初始开发成本，同时 Riot 敲定投资级信贷支持。

此次租赁是在 Riot 先前与 AMD 达成协议之后进行的，使 Rockdale 的合同产能达到 241 兆瓦，长期合同收入达到约 98 亿美元。 Riot 在第二季度交付了 AMD 的初始 25 MW 装机，并正在开发另外 25 MW 装机，预计于 2027 年 5 月交付。

H.C. 温赖特将拳头公司预期的科西卡纳转换纳入其估值中。 该 1 GW 站点可支持高达 756 MW 的关键 IT 负载，但一个租户仅提供了一份对该容量不具有约束力的意向书，而商业和设计讨论仍在继续。

截至 6 月，Riot 持有现金 5.489 亿美元，比特币价值约 6.66 亿美元。 H.C. 温赖特认为，比特币价格波动、网络哈希率增长、Rockdale 建设延迟以及二级股权销售稀释都是其估值面临的风险。
